page.notes: Right-hand column largely blanked; only edge fragments of its notes survive ("Sepulc", "Pif", "Hor"), which are uncertain. "Anco-niranus" is doubtful and may read Ancoranus. Page number "82" is read from a damaged head. The right page's top line is not visible in this part. The left-margin block and the diagram at the centre were read only partly; the top-left column is cut off. Several small Roman numerals and the Greek-free passages are doubtful. Marginal numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are line references beside the columns.
